context: Replace truthiness coalescing with explicit non-None resolution while preserving alias precedence. Add table-driven and round-trip tests for canonical and legacy aliases. Audit adjacent compact numeric/boolean fields for the same defect pattern, but record any distinct defect separately rather than widening this implementation. Preserve the v2 external shape unless evidence proves that a versioned migration is required.
description: A confirmed canonical-result defect in benchbox/core/results/schema.py uses truthiness-based alias selection for rows_returned, rows, and result_count. A successful query with rows_returned=0 therefore exports without the compact rows key, and benchbox/core/results/loader.py reconstructs None on reload. Repair the defect and establish an explicit missing/null/zero contract across all compatibility aliases. This is a narrow correctness fix; it does not authorize a broader result-schema redesign or schema-version migration.
